model.title: A bill to amend the National Trails System Act to direct the Secretary of the Interior to conduct a study on the feasibility of designating the Bonneville Shoreline Trail.
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. John Curtis (R-UT)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Secretary of the Interior to study whether the Bonneville Shoreline Trail is suitable for official designation as part of the National Trails System.
